lab_questions.title: Identify Items Below Restock Threshold
lab_questions.description:
An automated warehouse inventory management system tracks stock levels for all available products. Whenever an item's current stock drops below its predefined safety threshold, a restock order must be issued.

Your task is to read the total number of items N, followed by N current stock values and N restock threshold values, and output the total count of items that urgently require restocking (where current stock < restock threshold).

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
4
15 5 20 2
10 10 25 5
Expected Output: 3

solution.python:
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n = data[0]
    stock = data[1:n+1]
    thresh = data[n+1:2*n+1]
    print(sum(1 for s, t in zip(stock, thresh) if s < t))
